Yone|mid.identity: Crit-based fighter dealing mixed damage (physical and magic), played almost as much mid as top. Every second attack deals magic damage (passive). Mortal Steel (Q) strikes in a line and, on the third cast, dashes and knocks up enemies hit; Spirit Cleave (W) strikes in a cone and gives a shield; Soul Unbound (E) separates his soul from his body and, at the end, repeats part of the damage dealt; Fate Sealed (R) dashes through a line and pulls enemies hit.
Yone|mid.playstyle: In mid, Yone faces mages and assassins: he wins by dodging their abilities with E, then going all-in. He dominates Yasuo, his most common opponent, but struggles against mages who punish his dashes (Vex) or burst him (LeBlanc, Annie, Twisted Fate).
Yone|mid.early_game: Stack Q on minions to keep Q3 ready, short trades with Q + W. Keep E for all-ins: without it, you're an easy target for mages. Punish every missed key ability.
Yone|mid.level_2: Spirit Cleave (W). Q → W: a short trade with a shield.
Yone|mid.level_3: Soul Unbound (E). All-in: E → Q3 → W → attacks → snap back to your body.
Yone|mid.level_6: Fate Sealed: E → R → Q3 → W. Roam to the side lanes when your wave is pushed; in teamfights, aim for several targets.
power_spikes: Level 6: ultimate for kills and engages.
First completed item: heavy crit damage.
Two items: one of the best teamfight fighters.
Yone|mid.lane_plan: Stack Q, trade briefly and all-in when the enemy's key ability is on cooldown. Push and roam after level 6. The mid role quest (faster recall) makes your roams more profitable.
Yone|mid.trading: Short trade: Q → W → back off. All-in: E → Q3 → W → R → snap back. Give up on it against mages who punish your dashes (Vex) or burst you while your E is on cooldown.
threats: Vex: your hardest matchup (her passive stops your dashes).
LeBlanc, Annie and Twisted Fate, who burst or lock you down.
Ahri, a common and slightly unfavorable opponent.
mistakes: Using E when you can't snap back to safety.
Engaging inside a mage's control zone.

matchup_notes.Yasuo: He fights at your range: trade short and all-in with E.
matchup_notes.Viktor: Dive when his Gravity Field is on cooldown.
matchup_notes.Ahri: Dodge her Charm with E, then all-in.
matchup_notes.Zed: W to absorb his shurikens; E to dodge his ultimate.
matchup_notes.Vex: Her passive interrupts your dashes: farm and roam.

Yone|mid.mid_game: Roams, skirmishes and teamfights around objectives.
Yone|mid.late_game: Go in after the enemy CC, ultimate on several targets, then E to snap back.
Yone|mid.ahead: Roam, force fights and take objectives.
Yone|mid.behind: Farm and play teamfights after the enemy CC.
Yone|mid.win_condition: To win this game, you want to punish mages' missed abilities and clean up teamfights with your ultimate.
Yone|mid.final_tip: Before using E, look at where your body is: that's where you'll snap back to.
